name: Little Millet (Chama)
methodDescription: Picked by hand when the head bends. Pounded until the husk gives.
specimenCopy: Chama is what the Kurumba grow where other grains stop. It doesn't ask for much rain and doesn't leave when the water gets scarce. They've kept the same seeds through seasons that other crops didn't survive.

sensoryProfile.flavor: Subtle sweetness, clean, light on the palate
